M = 1000000007
visited = [False] * 1010101

def DFS(v, k, p):
    if not visited[v]:
        visited[v] = True
        DFS((v * k) % p, k, p)

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    Ans = 1
    if k == 1:
        Ans = p
    for i in range(1, p):
        if not visited[i]:
            DFS(i, k, p)
            Ans = (Ans * p) % M
    print(Ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
